policy: Coverage-only expansion from an explicitly adult creator/model-owned Flickr pool. Every work is individually verified as CC BY 2.0, images remain local in .tmp, and nothing becomes training-ready from this manifest.
limitations: All four examples come from one creator/model pool and therefore do not provide creator diversity.
These examples fill detector coverage gaps but are not modern Artes visual-style calibration.
Human review remains required before detector labels are accepted.
